data.text: I’m willing to commit to 12 tons this month too. That gives us a 40-ton reserve if everyone follows through, without assuming the natural refill will happen. For lean months, let’s agree on the actual whole-ton quotas before fishing, rather than treating 12 as an entitlement. And I agree with Jack: any excess catch should lead to discussion and a corrective agreement, not a race to empty the lake. Emma, does this compromise work for you? We still need your and Kate’s agreement.
